SEO software for small teams

Keyword research

Acme SEO software helps small teams find keyword research opportunities without a huge budget. Our keyword research workflow starts from a seed term and expands it into a scored list you can actually work through on a Monday morning. We built this because existing tools price out teams of under five people.

Rank tracking

Track positions daily and see which pages are in striking distance. Striking distance means positions eleven to twenty, where a small on-page change often moves you onto page one. Acme highlights those automatically.

Backlink analysis

See who links to you, what anchors they use, and which links you have lost. Anchor distribution matters more than most people think.
